description: The card dodges dialogs wherever they are parented, not just the ones on /root and /root/Main. Some dialogs belong to the phase controller that raises them -- the shooting phase's grenade and split-fire target pickers on /root/Main/ShootingController, the movement phase's menu -- and sit one level deeper than the two-level scan reached. Those were invisible to the overlay: the card never stepped aside AND _sync_modal_exit never fired, so its Exit Tutorial stayed live-looking while an exclusive modal swallowed every click. Companion to tut_t2_card_clears_formations_dialog, which covers the card fitting beside a dialog it CAN see; this one covers the ones it could not.

steps.comment: on a genuinely fresh profile the first-launch 'First time 'ere?' nudge is up, and its mouse_filter=STOP panel swallows clicks aimed at the menu behind it
ButtonSection sits below the menu's scroll fold at 1080p, and a click at an unscrolled control's coordinates lands on whatever is actually drawn there
stand-in for ShootingController's grenade / split-fire pickers, which need a board state this lesson cannot reach but sit at exactly this depth
the deep scan is throttled to 0.15s, so give discovery a moment

the delta this scenario exists for: the overlay now sees a dialog parented to a controller, and the card is clear of everything open. Placement itself is not asserted -- the card only moves when a dialog actually reaches it, which is tut_t2_card_clears_formations_dialog's territory
the other half: _sync_modal_exit now fires for these dialogs too, so the dead button is greyed instead of silently eating clicks

PopupMenu is a Window too, so the deep scan reaches dropdowns and context menus - they must not count. The lesson's own review dialog may still be open here, so this checks what is counted rather than that nothing is
